undated_mentions: Admitted to the Warsaw Conservatory as a percussion student
Excused from military service after failing his medical examination
Lived for some months in Paris and London
Returned to Poland shortly after the Anschluss
Moved to Krakow after World War II and composed film music for the Army Film Unit
Accepted post of Principal Conductor of the Krakow Philharmonic Orchestra
Appointed Music Director of the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra, then resigned in protest
Guest conducted the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra
Became Vice-President of ZKP (Związek Kompozytorów Polskich)
Sinfonia Rustica proscribed; Secretary of Culture announced it had ceased to exist
Awarded Standard of Labour First Class
Tragic Overture first performed at a charity concert during the occupation
Separated from Scarlett after she published a book about him
Moved into a house in Twickenham
Stokowski gave American premieres of Katyń Epitaph, Universal Prayer and Sinfonia Sacra
